What is TourAI

The official AI tourism app of the tourai.es project — maps, chat and audio guides at your own pace.

The project

TourAI is an independent digital tourism project created by Jordi Perelló, a developer and travel enthusiast based in Spain. We were born from a simple idea: that anyone should be able to explore a city with the same depth they would get from a local guide, but at their own pace, in their own language and from their mobile.

This website, tourai.es, is the official portal of the project: information about the app, contact, support and access to the private account area for registered users.

TourAI at tourai.es (official brand)

Search results may show other apps or brands with similar names («Tour AI», «TourAi», etc.). TourAI —spelled as one word with capital AI— is the independent project by Jordi Perelló in Spain. The app and this official website are at https://tourai.es; project contact is info@tourai.es. If you are looking for this app, check the domain and store links published on tourai.es.

What does TourAI do?

TourAI is a mobile application that combines artificial intelligence, geolocation and audio guides to offer a personalised travel experience:

  • AI chat: ask about monuments, history, restaurants or transport and receive contextualised answers.
  • Voice queries: interact with the app whilst walking, without stopping to type.
  • Interactive maps: discover nearby points of interest and start GPS-guided walks.
  • Immersive audio guides: listen to narrations triggered by your location as you approach each point.
  • Plans and bonuses: get a temporary plan or redeem a promotional bonus to use the map, chat and audio guides.

The application is currently in development and testing. The iOS and Android versions will be published in the official stores when they are ready.

How it works in practice

A typical TourAI walk combines map, assistant and narration on your phone:

  1. Choose destination and plan: sign in, activate a temporary plan or redeem a promotional bonus to unlock the map, chat and audio guides.
  2. Explore the map: find nearby points of interest and start a GPS-guided walk.
  3. Ask the assistant: use chat or voice for stories, practical tips or questions while you walk.
  4. Listen to audio guides: as you approach a point, the app can play narrations tied to your location.

More answers in the frequently asked questions.

Our mission

We want to democratise access to quality cultural information. We believe that travelling should not depend on booking expensive tours or carrying outdated printed guides. TourAI works with temporary plans and promotional bonuses that unlock full access to the app.
